verdict.rationale: PlanetScale's Insights/Schema Recommendations feature surfaces server-side analysis (query stats, failing patterns, anomalies, schema recommendations) computed from production data, and the 'self-improving database' + MCP integration lets AI agents review this data and generate improvement suggestions/PRs automatically — a community report even confirms Insights surfaced missing indexes that improved performance. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation that the underlying Insights/recommendation engine itself is AI/ML-generated (vs rule-based analytics) and independent evaluation of suggestion quality beyond one anecdote.
